label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Patient SYNTH-KNEE-006 is fictional: its age, sex and examination dates were chosen for the demo, and the two radiographs are images supplied for the demo, not verified films of one person.
notes: Both images were uploaded through the app's normal analysis path (POST /api/analyze) and each has its own stored record.

These images are not reference samples, so the meniscus, bone and implant numbers come from the platform's deterministic simulation (hash-seeded from the image bytes), not from measuring the anatomy. Image quality and the knee region are computed from the pixels.

The anatomical side (Right) was read from the images: the fibula lies to the viewer's left of the tibia and the follow-up film labels that knee R. The follow-up is a bilateral film; the pipeline picks the right knee.
A difference between the two measurement sets is a descriptive number only and says nothing about disease progression.
